about.summary: Glafira for Load Testing is a desktop tool for preparing and maintaining load tests. This version (stage L1) builds the registry of operations from the contracts of your services, exports the production-load template to Excel, imports the filled template and computes the load profile. The CLI runner, suites, mocks and reports come in the next stages.

support.title: Support the project
support.hint: Glafira is free and open source; donations keep it going.

project.folder: An empty folder inside your git repository: the project is a set of text files that you commit.
project.services: A service is a local git clone of the system under test; its contracts are found automatically or listed on the service tab.
project.environments: Addresses of your stands without passwords; secrets come with the runner in stage L2.

service.contracts: OpenAPI/Swagger, Protobuf, AsyncAPI, Avro and JSON Schema, Flyway/Liquibase migrations, Spring controllers. Each file is parsed on its own: an error in one does not stop the rest.
service.kafka: Topic to schema file (relative to the service folder). Direction is optional: by default it is taken from the AsyncAPI operation or the Spring annotation.

registry.title: Every operation of the system under test with its request and response schemas. Rescanning merges changes; manual fields survive.

prodLoad.title: The template is an .xlsx with locked IDs. The production team fills in the figures; import matches rows by ID and shows the diff before writing load/prod-load.yaml.

profile.title: Target RPS = production figure × k_env × k_growth; the share is its part of the sum. Phases set how the load changes over time; the runner (stage L2) executes them as is.
profile.coefficients: k_env — the stand's capacity relative to production, k_growth — the growth margin. An operation override wins over a service one, a service one over the global.

help.line1: Fill columns F–K on the Operations sheet with figures from production monitoring.
help.line2: Do not change column A (ID): the app matches rows by it.
help.line3: Rows you leave empty keep their previous figures in the project.
help.line4: Peak must not be below average; errors are a percentage from 0 to 100.
